data.name: Wizard.SetupWizardEpiloguePageContent
data.value:
That completes the basic setup.
You can launch the application with the "Launch" button at the bottom right. You can open the settings window with the gear icon at the top right. The wizard covers only a small part of the settings, and there are many more items, so try customizing it to your liking.
KyoshinEewViewer for ingen is still under development. If you notice any bugs or anything that feels off, feel free to contact the author. Contact information is on the bottom tab of the settings window.
---
## Tips for using the application ### I want to play sounds
You can do it from the "Sound" tab of the settings window. For items with a notation such as `{int}: max intensity`, you can change the file name to play depending on the maximum intensity and so on. If you specify `C:\Sound\{int}.wav`, then `C:\Sound\5+.wav` is played for intensity 5 lower.
### I want to use it for recording and so on
When using it for streaming or recording, the tab area at the top may get in the way. In that case, you can start it with command-line arguments in a special mode that shows only a specific tab. (The following is a Windows example)
- You can start it with `KyoshinEewViewer.exe -s <type>`. The type can be specified as - `kyoshin-monitor` Kyoshin Monitor - `earthquake` Earthquake information - `radar` Rain cloud radar - `qzss` DC Report
When started in this mode, the buttons at the bottom left are not shown, but they still exist, so you can click them to reset the map position or open the settings screen.

data.name: Wizard.StetupWizardDmdataPromotionContent
data.value:
## About [Project DM-D.S.S](https://dmdata.jp/)
This is a service that delivers earthquake information and more in real time using WebSocket and other methods. (paid) By default, KyoshinEewViewer for ingen receives earthquake information using the [JMA Disaster Prevention XML (PULL type)](http://xml.kishou.go.jp/xmlpull.html), but this method introduces a lag of **about 1 to 3 minutes** from announcement to reception. Using DM-D.S.S reduces it to **a few seconds**, allowing you to receive information at a speed equal to or faster than TV and apps provided by companies.
## Pricing
|Category|Price (monthly max)|Price (daily)| |---|---|---| |Earthquake Early Warning (forecast)|1650 JPY/month|75 JPY/day| |Earthquake Early Warning (warning)|440 JPY/month|20 JPY/day| |Earthquake / tsunami related|550 JPY/month|25 JPY/day|
(As of July 2022 / only items usable with this software)
To use it, please register an account and sign a contract, then link your account from the "DM-D.S.S" tab of the settings window after starting the application.
